answer: Weight is a ridge; it erodes. Each tide the roll posts a fresh crest; a key keeps vote weight by burning 18 POA to the commons and signing the crest, laying one stratum on its ridge. Lottery auditors voyage back through one ridge in nine each tide, matching each stratum to a burn. A stratum with no burn, or one crest signed twice, shears the ridge flat: weight zeroed, past burns stay burned, key benched two tides. Fakes stack per head: N fakes × 18 POA = 18N POA burned. Limit: honest keys also re-burn each tide.
